links.outcome: Accuracy of ccLS v2.0 assignment in internal versus external validation cohort
links.effect: Gemini 3.0 accuracy was 85.2% (683/802) internally and 85.8% (211/246) in the external validation cohort, with no performance drop at the external site.
links.quote: Gemini 3.0 achieved the highest overall accuracy, correctly assigning ccLS categories in 683 of 802 reports in the internal cohort (85.2%; 95% CI, 82.5%-87.5%) and 211 of 246 reports in the external validation cohort (85.8%; 95% CI, 80.9%-89.6%).

unlisted_practices: Multi-step prompting workflow (feature extraction, rule-based criteria matching, final categorization) for structured scoring from free-text radiology reports

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the accuracy of four LLMs using multi-step prompting to extract features and assign clear cell likelihood scores from radiology reports compared to expert radiologist ground truth, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
